alternative_interpretations: A routine pause during a group ride, with no symbolic intent—simply logistical coordination before continuing.
limitations: No facial expressions or gestures confirm intentionality; all interpretation relies on object placement alone.

alternative_interpretations: The image was converted to grayscale for aesthetic or technical reasons unrelated to meaning.
